newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Merita ups Finnish GDP growth outlook.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Merita ups Finnish GDP growth outlook.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy said on Thursday it raised its forecast for Finnish gross domestic product (GDP) growth in 1997 to 4.5 percent from 4.0 percent.
It forecast growth in 1998 at 3.5 percent.
"Already at the end of last year, growth accelerated stronger than expected and this year's demand outlook has improved slightly across the board," Merita said in a statement.
